tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid kyi rgyud 'debs bzhugs so//

༈ /dus 'khor bla brgyud la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru kā la tsakrā ye/ dus kyi 'khor lo zla ba bzang po dang*// lha dbang gzi brjid can dang zla bas byin// lha dbang sna tshogs gzung dang lha'i dbang ldan// 'jam dpal grags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma dkar po 'jam dbyangs sprul pa dang*// tsi lu paṇa chen pi ṭo a tsar+ya// dus zhabs chung ba mañju kirta'i zhabs// sa man+ta shrī rnams la= /rwa chos ye shes seṅge 'bum seng dang*// rga lo sher seng dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs// yon tan rgya mtsho bu ston rin chen grub// thugs sras lo tsā rnams la= /'jam dbyangs grags pa ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje bsod nams mchog grub zhabs// dkon mchog dpal bzang don grub rgyal mtshan dang*// rin chen bkra shis rnams la= /mkhyen brtse dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog grub klu sgrub rgyal mtshan zhabs// smon lam lhun grub blo bzang mkhas btsun dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po rnams la= /smon lam bsam gtan byams pa chos 'phel dang*// ye shes dpal 'byor blo gsal bstan skyong bar// bu lugs dbang chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho kun mkhyen dol po pa// sgra 'gyur sku mched phyogs las rnam rgyal rje// kun dga' dpal ba sred pa kun blo'i zhabs// dkon mchog bzang po rnams la= /nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*// 'jam mgon grol mchog rin chen rgya mtsho dang*// ta ra na tha thugs sras rgya mtsho gnyis// blo gros rnam rgyal rnams la= /ngag dbang 'phrin las kun bzang dbang po dang*// tshe dbang nor bu bstan pa'i nyin 'byed dang*// 'phrin rnam pad nyi bar byon 'khrid rgyud dang*// jo zhal dbang khrid kun 'dus mkhyen brtse rje// mdzod lnga'i bdag nyid yon tan rgya mtsho zhabs// blo gter dbang po rnams la=

/bstan pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi nyi ma dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang*// ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po yis// rjes bzung rtsa ba'i bla mar= / bu lugs dbang rgyun la shin tu nye brgyud ni/ (rgyal ba'i yum mchog ye shes mkha' 'gro mas// dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ku shā'i rtswa// mkha' spyod nas bsnams dbang rtags phyir du gnang*// mkhyen rab chos rje'i zhabs la=) /dpal ldan brgyud rim rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// thun mong thun min sngon 'gros rgyud sbyang nas// lam gyi dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa yi// dag pa gsum gyi 'khor lo brtan par shog /de yang gya nom zhen pa'i skyon sbyang phyir// rtogs bral rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings gzir bas// 'od gsal rtags rdzogs sor sdud 'byongs pa dang*// g.yo bral dga' bde'i bsam gtan mthar phyin shog /zung 'dzin rgyu ba dhu tir tshud pa yis// tsan ṭas zhu bde'i srog stsol tshad du phyin// 'dzag med 'dzin pa mthar phyin khams rgyas pas// phyag chen lam gyi rjes dran 'grub par shog /zab lam sbyor bas dwang ma gtsug tu bsti// spros med lam la dbang 'byor ting 'dzin brtan// dus gsum rgyal kun bgrod lam sbyor drug gis// don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i dge legs stsol// ces pa bla mchod nang gi brgyud rim la kha bskong dang lam rim smon lam gsar du mdor bsdus zhig dgos zhes rgyal rong bi sho'i 'phrul ldan gsum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhyen rab mchog sbyin lags nas skyes bcas bka' stsal ma ldog tsam du/ rgyud dang khrid gzhung sogs la zhib blta ma khom yang rang blos gang zin mdor bsdus su bco brgyad pa lha btsun su bha ṣi tas rang lo nyer gsum lor mdor bsdus su bris pa/

slar rang lo re dgu sa 'brug nag zla'i dus chen skabs bal yul byams chen lha khang du bu lugs dbang chen jo lugs sbyor drug 'khrid bcas 'don skabs skad 'gyur rang gi dwang slob a ri ba ngag dbang bsam gtan (sa'i re si)nas rgyud 'debs mdor bsdus 'di'i thog sbyor drug 'khrid kyi brgyud rim yod pa dgos zhes bskul ba ltar slar yang su bha ṣi tas byams chen lha khang yid dga' chos 'dzin gling du bris pa'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge snying po grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ring mchog drug /gcig bsdus khyab bdag rdo rje sems// bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhabs// dad brgya'i gtsug gi nor bus mchod// khro phu lo tsā ba chen po las rim par brgyud pa'i dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs la gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ shu n+ya tā sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang*// zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor// zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa// lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po bskyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying ga mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o// rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan cing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang gu/ gsang bar k+ṣa sngon po rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pa'o// snying gar rnam bcu dbang ldan brtsegs par gyur par bsams nas/ oṃ hā swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab mthar mi dmigs par bzhag gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// sogs bsngo smon gang shes kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi// sgrub thabs tshangs la ma nor ba// gang 'di khro phu lo tsā ba'i// gsung bzhin bkod 'dis dge gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
